## Achievements: Pluto Tester
-# 4 of 10 badges earned

**Earned**
**Opening Score**: Win a head-to-head bet.
**Double Figures**: Win 10 head-to-head bets.
**In the Black**: Hold a positive net profit across at least 10 settled head-to-head bets. You keep it only while you still qualify.
**Due a Win**: Have 5 bets, predictions or parlays settle. The result does not matter.

**Still to earn**
**Club Fifty**: Win 50 head-to-head bets.
-# H2H wins 37/50
**The Line Reader**: Keep a hit rate of 60% or better across at least 20 settled predictions.
-# Settled predictions 20/20 (done) · Prediction hit rate 55.0% of 60%
**Player’s Edge**: Get 10 player prop predictions right.
-# Correct player props 6/10
**All Legs Home**: Win a parlay.
-# Won parlays 0/1
**Courtside**: Get 10 NBA predictions right.
-# Correct NBA predictions 3/10
**Trust the Process**: Have 50 bets, predictions or parlays settle across at least 20 different games.
-# Settled choices 41/50 · Different games 17/20
-# Badges are just for show. Pluto updates them when you open a profile or this list.
